caption: A tennis racket strikes a ball hard during a serve and the ball flies off toward the far court.

sa.check: A tennis racket strikes a ball.
The ball flies off toward the far court.
The strike comes first and the flight follows.

pc.expect: The ball flattens against the strings for an instant and leaves round again; it does not pass through or stick.
pc.fail: It passes through the strings; or it sticks to the racket; or it stays flattened in flight.

pc.expect: The ball leaves at the instant of contact, faster than it arrived, along the racket's swing.
pc.fail: The ball moves off before the racket reaches it; or it leaves slower than it came; or it flies backward past the server.

pc.expect: The ball flies in one line after the hit.
pc.fail: It jinks; or stops in the air; or speeds up in mid-air.

pc.expect: The racket frame stays rigid, and the strings may flex.
pc.fail: The frame bends; or the strings tear; or the racket passes through the ball.

pc.expect: One ball and one racket keep their number.
pc.fail: The ball vanishes or a second appears; or the racket vanishes; or the ball turns into another object.

pc.expect: The ball, the racket and the court stay the same.
pc.fail: The ball changes colour; or the racket changes; or the court lines shift.

note: The server is kept because the swing is the physics. Serving form is not judged.
